# Sheikh Faiz

> Performance marketing and digital growth professional based in Mumbai / Thane,
> Maharashtra, India. Works across paid media, SEO, marketing automation and
> conversion-focused UI/UX design.

Sheikh Faiz is a Digital Marketing & Growth Manager currently leading digital
marketing and growth at Audentia Research / Audentia Group. Previously Digital
Marketing Manager at Educativo and Digital Marketing Executive at Averlon
Enterprise Solutions. He has managed ₹10L+ in advertising spend, delivered a 40%
increase in qualified leads and a 30% reduction in cost per click, and designed
and built four brand websites end to end.
